story: Thirty pounds lighter on the shot, yet the stairs feel harder than before.
cluster_description: Proposed market: men losing weight on a GLP-1 shot who feel weaker and drained.
icp_description: The man on a GLP-1 who is lighter on the scale but weaker in daily life.
pain_description: Energy, muscle and nutrients drop along with the weight.
source: Competitor angle (Ancestral, men on GLP-1); Vital Bull has no GLP-1 cluster.

story: He's lean everywhere except his chest, and a loose shirt hides it daily.
cluster_description: Proposed market: men with chest fat who read it as a hormone and stress problem.
icp_description: The man who trains and eats well but cannot shift chest fat.
pain_description: Stubborn chest and belly fat he blames on cortisol and estrogen.
source: Competitor angle (Primal Viking since June, Primal Edge copying); no Vital Bull line.

story: Two beers used to be nothing; now alcohol flattens him for days.
cluster_description: Proposed market: men for whom drinking now costs energy and recovery.
icp_description: The man over thirty whose body no longer handles alcohol like it did.
pain_description: Alcohol hits harder and the liver feels tired.
source: Competitor angle (Primal Viking); Beef Liver's alcohol lines are our largest, none exists for Vital Bull.

story: Doctor looks at his belt and says it's not the beer, it's the liver.
cluster_description: Proposed market: men over 55 whose belly and low energy point to a fatty liver.
icp_description: The older man told his belly is a liver problem, not a beer problem.
pain_description: A growing belly and low energy tied to a tired liver.
source: Competitor angle (Forge, doctor-story advertorials started Nov 3-5); Beef Liver's belly line is below average, so test the male version small.

story: Reindeer, bison or beef organs: he wants to know which dose is real.
cluster_description: Existing market: men who want the nutrients of organ meats.
icp_description: The buyer who compares organ supplements on source and dose before buying.
pain_description: Not knowing which brand's sourcing and dose is honest.
source: Competitor angle (Primal Viking reindeer vs beef since May, Primal Edge, Beef Organ Guide); our Label Reader lines are the nearest.

story: Only two good weeks a month, and cramps and short cycles eat the rest.
cluster_description: Proposed market: women whose monthly cycle drives their energy and mood.
icp_description: The woman with cramps, short cycles and PMS who feels good only part of the month.
pain_description: Hormone swings she feels in energy, mood and her cycle.
source: Competitor angle (Heart & Soil Her Package, 17+ ads since Sep 1); closest of ours is B20 Perimenopause Prepper.

story: Tired, foggy and stuck on weight, she suspects her thyroid is running on empty.
cluster_description: Proposed market: women who link tiredness, fog and weight to their thyroid.
icp_description: The woman over 30 chasing symptoms and wondering about her thyroid.
pain_description: Constant tiredness, brain fog and stubborn weight.
source: Competitor angle (Heart & Soil and Ancestral thyroid funnels).

story: The first grays showed up at thirty-two, and nobody ever mentioned copper.
cluster_description: Proposed market: people seeing grey hair early who want a nutrient reason.
icp_description: The person who found their first grays well before expected.
pain_description: Early grey hair, tied in the ad to a copper gap.
source: Competitor angle (Ancestral creator video Oct 29); the pain point exists on the tracker Lists tab but not on our sheet.

story: She cooks everything from scratch, yet her kids still miss iron and B12.
cluster_description: Existing market: mothers around pregnancy and early parenting.
icp_description: The mother who feeds her children whole foods and worries about gaps.
pain_description: Iron and B12 shortfalls in a household that already eats well.
source: Competitor angle (Love Ya Guts, Ancestral and Folqs postpartum wave).

story: Bruises keep showing up on thin skin, and she blames age or her pills.
cluster_description: Existing market: collagen and beauty-from-within buyers.
icp_description: The older woman whose skin has thinned and bruises easily.
pain_description: Thin, fragile skin she writes off as age or medication.

story: Desire faded with her hormones, and nobody told her it can come back.
cluster_description: Existing market: women in perimenopause and menopause.
icp_description: The woman whose desire has dropped since her hormones changed.
pain_description: Lost desire that she assumes is permanent.

story: Menopause made her joints ache, and stairs now feel like something to dread.
cluster_description: Existing market: women whose joints changed with menopause.
icp_description: The woman who buys on bone marrow as the reason her joints hurt.
pain_description: Joint pain and stair fear that started in menopause.
source: Competitor angle (My Marrow, Primal Queen Marrow, direct Boneflex competitors); our bone-marrow line BF51 reads strongest on Boneflex.

story: A familiar TV voice tells her, in Spanish, how her knees can feel again.
cluster_description: Proposed market: Spanish-speaking joint buyers reached in their own language.
icp_description: The Spanish-speaking buyer who trusts a known personality.
pain_description: Joint pain, in the buyer's own language and voice.

flag: NEW LINE inside Aging in Place & Mobility
story: No time for eight bottles, so she wants one simple joint routine.
cluster_description: Existing market: people keeping mobile as they age.
icp_description: The busy mother who wants fewer, better supplements.
pain_description: Too many bottles and too little time.

story: Eight bottles crowd her counter, and none delivered what the label promised.
cluster_description: Proposed market: buyers who want one product to replace a cabinet of supplements.
icp_description: The buyer with a shelf of joint and wellness bottles.
pain_description: Money and counter space spent on stacks that did not work.
source: Competitor angle (Folqs eight-organ pouch, Haka 'tried everything'); our Build-My-Stack offer lines are working.
